<section>Chapter 31. Cryptography Extensions: Scalar & Entropy Source Instructions, Version 1.0.1 > 31.7. Instruction Rationale > 31.7.4. Bitmanip Instructions for Cryptography > 31.7.4.4. Logic With Negate > Notes to software developers</section>
<previous>#### **31.7.4.4. Logic With Negate**

```
RV32, RV64:
    andn rd, rs1, rs2
```

```
     orn rd, rs1, rs2
    xnor rd, rs1, rs2
```

See Bit-manipulation for Cryptography for details of these instructions. These instructions are useful inside hash functions, block ciphers and for implementing software based side-channel countermeasures like masking. The `andn` instruction is also useful for constant time word-select in systems without the ternary Bitmanip `cmov` instruction.</previous>
